# ScreenHarmony Flex v2.9.1 (Alpha Preview)

## Key Updates
- **Exact Alarm & Schedule Automation**: Full Android 12–14+ support with auto-rescheduling upon permission grant.
- **Multi-OEM Anti-Tamper Shield**: Intercepts uninstallation and force-close attempts across Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, and Huawei.
- **Background Autostart Resilience**: Play Store compliant OEM settings navigation and runtime notification handling.
- **Remote Device Wake-Up**: Instant wake triggers with 1-minute freshness validation and real-time connectivity alerts.
- **Optimized CI/CD Release Engine**: Dual-flavor release packaging with automatic Pre-Release detection.
